content.text: Kerala Ayush Counselling 2025 is conducted by the Commissioner of Entrance Examinations (CEE). The NEET-UG qualified candidates who registered for the KEAM can participate in the Ayush Counselling in Kerala. The counselling is undergone for admission to Ayurveda/Naturopathy/Unani/Siddha/Homeopathy courses in government and private colleges in Kerala.
The NEET-UG Examination was conducted on 4 May 2025, and the results are out now.

This article will act as a guide to the Kerala Ayush Counselling 2025 and provide the important details such as counselling, registration, fees, cutoff, and allotment procedure. Let’s begin with an overview of the counselling process, with the number of colleges participating.

The Commissioner of Entrance Examinations(CEE) conducts the Kerala Ayush Counseling for Ayush Courses- BAMS/BNYS/BUMS/BSMS/BHMS . The candidates must register for KEAM to participate in the Ayush Counselling in Karnataka. NEET is the primary eligibility criterion for admission to Ayush colleges in Kerala. https://cee.kerala.gov.in/ is the Kerala Ayush Counselling official website. The NEET-qualified candidates must register for KEAM on the official website of CEE and participate in the counselling process.

The counselling is done for admission to seats under the State Quota and the All India Quota. There are 18 BAMS colleges , 6 BHMS colleges, 1 BUMS and BSMS colleges each in Kerala. 85% of the private and government college seats in Kerala are reserved for Kerala state domicile candidates under the State Quota, and the remaining 15% of the seats are under All India Category (AIQ), open to all category candidates, including non-domicile or students from other states. The counselling for AIQ seats is handled by the AACCC .

sections.heading: Centralized Admission Process (CAP) & Online Submission of Options

items: The Centralized Admission Process (CAP) is conducted by the Commissioner of Entrance Examinations (CEE) for admission to Ayush Courses.
The candidates can register their options for courses and colleges through the CEE Kerala website. The options should be registered only if the candidates are willing to join if allotted.

The candidates should register with the website of cee.gov.in with the login id and password. Fill out the application form with basic personal details and make payment of the registration fees through the online payment gateway or e-chalan.
Upload the necessary original documents and certificates as instructed.
The candidates must attend the document verification procedure at the designated center with all the necessary original documents. After verification, the documents can be retained.
Upon the opening of the preference form, candidates must log in with their credentials and fill out their choices of colleges from the available options.
It is mandatory to lock the options before the final date to proceed to the allotment rounds.
Seat allotment is processed in multiple rounds. There is a total of 4 rounds: Round 1/Round 2/Round 3/Stray Vacancy Round.

Allotment is made under the State Merit Quota, irrespective of the reservation policy benefits. After all the State Merit Quota seats are filled, the remaining seats are allotted as per the respective reservation of the category, as per the reservation policy.
Stray Vacancy seats allotment is only made for the vacant seats. The candidates who did not secure seats in any of the previous rounds can participate in the Stray Vacancy Round.
The final allotment list will be published on the official website of CEE after considering the NEET scores, the reservation policy, choice options of the candidates.
The candidates must join the college they are finally allotted and produce the necessary original certificates to process further admission.
They must pay the prescribed fees in the institution within the timeframe to confirm their seats.

sections.heading: Kerala Ayush Counselling Process- All India Quota

content.text: The following is the detailed procedure for Kerala Ayush Counselling 2025 under the All India Quota.

items: The counselling for All India Quota seats is carried out by the Ayush Admissions Central Counseling Committee (AACCC). The candidates must register with the official website of AACCC at aaccc.gov.in .
Log in using the ID and password to fill out the application form with personal information and make payment of the registration fee as prescribed according to the category.
Upload the necessary original documents and certificates.

Choice filling round involves the candidates filling out their preferences for colleges in the option entry form. Fill in the choices by selecting the state Kerala, and choose colleges from the available list.
After filling in the options, choices must be locked before the last date to proceed to further rounds of counselling.

The allotment will be held in a total of 4 rounds. The Stray Vacancy round is there for the remaining vacant seats after 3 rounds of allotment. Eligibility and participation for each round are different.
After considering the NEET scores, choices of colleges, and reservation policy, seats are allotted, and the final Allotment List is published on the official website of AACCC.

The candidates allotted seats should report to the college with the necessary certificates for verification. The original certificates must be submitted to the college, photocopies will not be accepted.
Make payment of the prescribed fees to confirm the seat at the allotted college.
